# Department OKRs 2026-Q3

Objective and key-result grammar:
- Objective headings: `## O1 — <objective>`
- Key result lines: `- O1.KR1: <baseline> → <target> by <date>`
- `tools/cascade_check.py` parses exactly this shape.

## O1 — Example objective

- O1.KR1: baseline → target by YYYY-MM-DD

## O2 — Another objective

- O2.KR1: baseline → target by YYYY-MM-DD
